'''Bondu''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] hero. They were considered ancient<ref name="GCG" /> during the last [[Local year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="GC6">{{GamerCite|6|Bounties to Die For}}</ref> and the Twi'lek surname "Bonduna" meant "descended from Bondu."<ref name="GCG" /> The Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|male]] celebrity and [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Skawn Bonduna]] possessed the surname.<ref name="GC6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bondu was first mentioned in the [[2003]] supplement book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="GCG" />
